name: triage-gate
description: Flags a turn that wrote a lot and offers a /guide reading order; before Claude commits, measures the change's blast radius and asks Jev about risk and readability, then lets it through, flags it, or holds it for review.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for Jev. Left empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is used; with neither, triage uses blast radius alone.

codexModel.title: Codex review model
codexModel.description: Model for the Codex review, for example a cheaper one. Left empty, Codex uses its own default.
